payload.core_mechanism_summary: Identify masks appearing at least twice; for each, add skills of all students whose mask is a submask, avoiding duplicates. This implements the calm group condition where every student has a superset-mask peer.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all distinct masks, then for each mask with count>=2 (exist at least twice), sums the skills of all masks that are subsets. This exhaustive subset relation check is a complete search over bitmask subsets, not a greedy choice.
